name: Avatar
purpose: Represents a user or entity in a compact, typically circular form. Three content variants — an uploaded image, the user's initials, or a placeholder icon — in three sizes, with on-light and on-dark treatments.

variants.name: image
variants.use: Avatar showing an uploaded photo; image opacity 100% default / 20% disabled (image/opacity tokens).

variants.name: initials
variants.use: Avatar showing the user's initials in medium-weight text on a subtle surface.

variants.name: icon
variants.use: Placeholder avatar showing a generic person icon when no image/initials available.

accessibility.focus: Use default native focus states; all focusable elements must show a visible outline when tabbed to
accessibility.textSize: Must not break when font size is increased to 400%
accessibility.general: Adhere to the HSBC Accessibility Framework (create.hsbc/Guidelines/Accessibility.html); new dev reviewed by Brand Design Team
accessibility.screenReader: REVIEW (inferred): image/icon avatars need an accessible name (e.g. the person's name) or be marked decorative if adjacent text already names them

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): using an avatar as the sole accessible label for a control — pair with a text name
REVIEW (inferred): shrinking the tappable area below 44×44 even when the visual avatar is small (36px)
REVIEW (inferred): relying on the deprecated surface/border tokens long-term (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS (values resolve) but 6 DEPRECATED bindings, NONE with a live equivalent

depricateUsage.blocker: ALL six are confidence=review in the replacement map — no live semantic token shares their values. So they CANNOT be auto-rebound. The live semantic layer appears to be MISSING a subtle surface + border family (and on-dark disabled text/icon) that Avatar depends on. These deprecated tokens MUST NOT be bulk-deleted until live equivalents are created and Avatar is rebound — otherwise Avatar's fill/border/disabled states detach. Escalate to Dave / the Sutherland remap.
